task.title: Combined weeks paid exceed allowed shareable benefits

step.cmd: Determine if the number of weeks paid is equal to the number of weeks of entitlement shown in FTS:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 2.
If no, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the WP status is 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended):

ul.li: If yes, error code 312 is generated and an IPOC officer must make the change. Go to step 3.
If no, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 22 - Change to special benefits counter .
Remarks line 1: Type “312 error code. Parental entitlement paid in full and WP deferred.”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change entitlement parental weeks to [XX], DE35, start [XXXX], end 9999 OP Code 31F04.”
Remarks line 3: Type “ WP deferral rescind” if it was deferred in error.
Remarks line 5: Enter [officer’s name and telephone number].
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 97 - Internal adjustment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .
Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction, impose a D35 and input the conversion as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Revival: Select the appropriate Sunday.
Claim type: Select 2 - Regular .

Select the Special Benefits (M106) link and in the Parental section, do the following:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of entitlement (the total number of weeks the client is entitled to).
Select Save .
Action: Select Add.
Disentitlement: Select 35 - Parental benefits, qualifying conditions not met .
Start date: Select the first week the parent was overpaid parental benefit weeks.
End date: Select Indefinite .

Waiting period: Take the appropriate action:
If the WP was deferred in error, select X - Rescind.
If the WP was not deferred but should be, select 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non fraud - Other .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 9.

step.cmd: On day 1, in FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and impose a D35 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 35 - Parental benefits, qualifying conditions not met .
Start date: Select the first week the parent was overpaid parental benefit weeks.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non fraud - Other .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On day 2, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Select the Special Benefits (M106) link and in the Parental section, do the following:
Entitlement weeks: Enter the number of weeks of entitlement (the total number of weeks the client is entitled to).
Select Save .
Waiting period: If the WP should be deferred, select 5 - Waiting period deferred (parental standard or extended) .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: If the client is entitled to some weeks, select Special benefits approved (3046) .
If the client is not entitled to any weeks, select Special benefits denied (3065) .

If a D35 is imposed, select Parental benefits denied or suspended - D34/D35/D56/D57/Free text (3074) .
Select D35 - Not qualified or entitled (various reasons) (3077) .
Select D35 - Parental weeks already paid to one or more other people .
Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485): Select Indefinite disentitlement start date (1270) and enter the date.
Overpayment message (2452) .
If the parent is not entitled to a deferral of the WP because the WP has not yet been served, select Waiting period message (2445) .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration.
If an N-00-00-00 letter was previously sent for this PW, select This letter replaces or footnote (2365) .

step.cmd: In NWS, for each parent, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Parental benefit entitlement review.”

Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Type “Entitlement review for shared parental benefits complete.” Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the benefits sharing issue.
